description.text: Restores HP (55), grants [Last Stand] and [Haste], grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Eiko], [Apex Terra Homing Ability Tracker] and [Apex Terra Homing Level]

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Eiko
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Terra Homing (0~2), removed after using Apex Terra Homing two times

description.name: Apex Terra Homing Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Terra Homing level by 1 after using 7 Summoning or White Magic abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Eiko]

description.name: Apex Terra Homing Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Terra Homing level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Eiko]
